title: Potato and Mushroom Soup
subtitle: with sauteed mushrooms
description: A creamy-textured blended potato, carrot and mushroom soup, topped with butter-sauteed mushrooms and parsley.

steps.text: Put the roughly chopped onion, peeled and chopped potatoes, carrot, whole garlic cloves, celery and sliced button mushrooms in a pot with 2 litres of water. Cook for 30-40 minutes, or until the potatoes are soft.
Transfer the contents of the pot, including half the cooking water, to a blender and blend until smooth. Add more cooking water to thin if needed.
Return to the pot and cook over low heat for 10 minutes more. Taste and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a frying pan with the butter and saute the sliced Swiss brown mushrooms until they brown and soften. Season with parsley, salt and pepper.
Add the sauteed mushrooms to the soup and ladle into serving bowls.
